description: An application submitted under Section 96a of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a non-material amendment in connection with the planning permission dated 18/08/2025 application reference 24/0146/F for "Demolition of existing car wash and pet hospital and any associated structures and the re-development of the site for a mixed-use development, including buildings ranging from 3 to 17 storeys, comprising a re-provided 588 sqm pet hospital (E(e) use) floorspace, 487 co-living rooms accommodation (sui generis), 110 bedroom hotel accommodation (C1 use), 49 car parking spaces, cycle parking, hard and soft landscaping measures including playspace provision and refuse and recycling facilities", to consist of -Amendments to the 'trigger' points of planning conditions 20 (Refuse and recycling provision), 32 (Wheelchair accessibility), 37 (Landscaping Strategy), 46 (Accessibility) and 54 (Cycle Parking)
